Chapter 6416: Attack

Chapter 6416: Attack

Someone rode the wave closer to Imperial League, splitting the ocean into two halves.

His primal aura resembled a spear instilling fear into all emperors and desolate gods. It was domineering, not distinguishing between friends and foes.

“Boom!” Powerful barriers activated around Imperial League.

This area consisted of thousands and thousands of islands; some were as large as continents. They were under the jurisdiction of Virtuoso and Thousand-eyed Emperor.

These emperors combined their territories to form Imperial League. Ocean-gaze Ancestor then blessed them with foundation.

The newcomer was up there in age. Although he didn’t have a physical weapon, his aura took the shape of a spear.

It became larger and larger, instilling fear into all spectators.

“Iron Spear Ancestor!” Alch-deer murmured: “What is this old man doing? All aggressive, clearly not here for a simple visit.”

“Trinity’s ancestor.” Virtuoso became serious and sent a message to the others: “Be on guard.”

This was no guest and the timing was terrible due to the dream spreading everywhere.

Iron Spear was Trinity’s new primal ancestor, having reached this realm nearly one hundred thousand years ago.

Ocean-gaze came from Trinity just like Whale Ancestor. They still maintained a civil relationship with Trinity after leaving.

Today, Iron Spear’s arrival could be for Ocean-gaze’s birthday. However, his aggression said otherwise.

“Bam!” The barriers halted his advance.

“Break!” He became furious and sent the energy spear into the barriers.

“Boom!” The impact birthed tidal waves but the barriers only shook violently.

All the emperors empowered it along with the overarching momentum. A new primal ancestor such as Iron Spear couldn’t break it down.

“Is this how you treat a guest?” Iron Spear’s gaze illuminated the islands. He looked like the ruler looming above everyone.

“May I ask what you are here, primal ancestor?” Virtuoso asked.

“I can’t celebrate Ocean-gaze Ancestor’s birthday despite being a sect member?” Iron Spear responded.

The emperors exchanged glances because there was no problem with this statement. Trinity had also sent a guest during Ocean-gaze’s two-millionth birthday.

Eventually, Virtuoso’s group agreed to let him in because turning away a guest was unacceptable.

“It’s a strange period, please forgive us.” Virtuoso said.

“Where is Brother Ocean-gaze?” Iron Spear got straight to the point.

Although the emperors knew he wasn’t here to celebrate, they still had to oblige.

“The primal ancestor is not here.” Virtuoso said.

“Not here during his birthday?” Iron Spear didn’t buy it.

“The primal ancestor wanted peace and didn’t announce it to anyone. We do appreciate your kind intent.” Virtuoso lowered his head.

They spoke the truth since Ocean-gaze spent it alone, going as far as boiling his own longevity noodle.

Moreover, a character such as himself didn’t necessarily care about conventional celebrations.

“Then you all can be in charge in his absence.” Iron Spear said.

Virtuoso didn’t like the sound of this but pretended to be calm: “May I ask regarding what matter, Senior?”

“Isles of Evil appeared in this region, yes?” Iron Spear pointed upward at the illusory mirror world.

“Yes, we don’t know why it appeared above us.” Virtuoso said: “That’s why we prepared our defense and offended you, Senior.”

“Perfect, since you are ready for war, launch an attack against the isles.” Iron Spear said commandingly.

“Attack?” Virtuoso frowned.

“A lair of villains, all deserve death.” Iron Spear said.

“That’s the only reason?” Virtuoso wasn’t moved by the call for justice.

“Trinity’s traitor is there so it’s the perfect time to hunt her.” Iron Spear said.
